question.question_text: Has anyone else told you this problem is real, or is this based only on your own experience so far?

history.question_text: When you picture doing this really well, what does 'well' actually mean to you — being first, being the best, or being trusted?
history.answer_text: For me, “doing it really well” means being *trusted*—because in compliance, one missed clause can hurt people and kill customer confidence. We already try to be “best” on accuracy (we auto-generate with audit-ready traceability), but the win condition I’m optimizing for is retention: keeping churn at ~3% by getting customers to finish onboarding and actually rely on the platform every month/quarter. If we’re trusted, we’ll naturally grow to Rs 4 cr ARR and become the default tool, but “being first” isn’t the goal—I care whether customers stick and renew.
